'''Tuskbeasts''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]]. [[Mutant|Mutated]] a large dose of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[M'dweshuu]], the tuskbeasts became large predators. TKintan was also the homeworld of the sentient [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] species which hunted tuskbeasts and eventually drove them to [[Death/Legends|extinction]] by [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. 

==Biology and appearance==
Tuskbeasts were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]]<ref name="GG12" /> predatory.<ref name="LONH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> [[Species/Legends|species]] of animal that had [[Color/Legends|gray-colored]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. They were capable of growing to a giant size<ref name="GG12" /> and possessed both [[Bone/Legends|bones]] and ivory.<ref name="LONH" />

==History==
[[File:Tuskbeast_pike_LoNH.png|thumb|right|300px|The Nikto used tuskbeast pikes (pictured) to hunt the beasts.]]
The tuskbeast species was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]]<ref name="GG12" /> in the [[Kintan system/Legends|Kintan system]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> of the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. [[Mutant|Mutations]] that occurred over several thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] led to the evolution of the species. These mutations were caused by a large dose of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] which originated from [[M'dweshuu]], a [[Star/Legends|star]] located at the heart of the Si'Klaata cluster, going [[Nova/Legends|nova]].<ref name="GG12" /> The sentient [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] species, who were also native to Kintan, used a type of [[tuskbeast pike|pike]] named after the tuskbeasts to hunt the fearsome predators. The [[Pike/Legends|pike]]'s hafts were traditionally carved from the ivory and bone of slain tuskbeasts.<ref name="LONH" /> By [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Extinct Date">[[Tuskbeast]]s are stated toto be extinct in ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''. The scenarios in the roleplaying reference book take place while the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] is active in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Since ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' establishes that the Rebel Alliance was created in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the tuskbeasts have become extinct by that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> the Nikto had driven the tuskbeasts to [[Death/Legends|extinction]] due to the threat they posed.<ref name="GATOR">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'' states that the Nikto drove all life on Kintan to extinction except flora and smaller non-threatening species. Due to their giant size and description as dangerous creatures this page assumes tuskbeast were among those driven to extinction.</ref> Many Nikto still carried tuskbeast pikes even after the species extinction.<ref name="LONH" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Tuskbeasts were first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'' a [[1995]] supplement book released as part of the ''[[Galaxy Guide]]'' series for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[West End Games]].<ref name="GG12" />
